verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of automatic receipt-to-card-transaction matching, e-receipts pulled from integrations, or targeted missing-receipt reminders. The marketing line that transactions are "automatically compliant" is too vague to count as receipt matching. The 2/3-way matching evidence concerns purchase orders and bills, and attachment upload covers bills, vendors, customers and invoices; both are adjacent features that earn no credit for this story.
